Independent Study · LB-AO · Phase D, Stage D2

Which muscles do the work in a squat

The same side-view squat as Stage D1, now with 14 leg muscles from the OpenSim Gait2392 model. At each instant the model finds the least total muscle effort that still produces the joint torques the squat needs. Where the muscles cannot, a labelled “reserve” torque makes up the gap, and the page says so.
